generationPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept game asset, transparent world sprite preview. Image 1 role: style and material reference only; do not edit or copy its multi-blade icon composition. Content ID / role: SKILL-003, one individual orbital blade projectile/world object. Intended use: a single blade duplicated by Unity and continuously orbited around the player; it must read at roughly 28–40 screen pixels while moving. View/composition: square master, isolated object, 3/4 top-down gameplay view, centered pivot, blade points horizontally to the right, compact slightly crescent silhouette, visible object fills about 68% of canvas, generous even transparent padding for rotation. Style: stylized 2D storybook cutout, hand-drawn, chunky and highly readable; thick slightly irregular deep-plum outer contour near #241B2B; flat matte silver steel, muted bronze/amber hub, simple cel-shading with one broad neutral-warm highlight; subtle dry-brush texture only inside large color masses. Design: one short broad curved blade with a compact reinforced bronze root and round amber rivet; clearly a single orbiting weapon, not a ring and not a thrown disk. Strong silhouette with no fragile needle-thin tip. Output: genuinely transparent background, clean RGBA alpha, no halo, no baked shadow. Avoid: multiple blades, circular sweep, trail, glow, speed lines, sparks, impact particles, ground plane, scene, frame, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, character, hands, photorealism, 3D render, pixel art, tiny ornament, cropped edges.
